scope: Experimental VM-native adapter port of actual ffistorage and direct source-backed tests; not an upstream Tecs change, full original ECS suite, or actual snapshot benchmark acceptance
adaptations: Replace LuaJIT CType bitfield decoding with canonical normalized native descriptor fields; retain original C scalar fingerprint labels, widths and declaration order.

Replace ffi allocations, bulk copy/fill and pointer arithmetic with physical managed NativeStorage arrays and bounded views; retain unused row zero, one-based live rows, overflow checks, resize, clearing, and custom allocation contract.
Use experimental VM-only castWritableElements and isBorrowed APIs through the dynamic storage boundary; owned captures retain identity and borrowed row captures detach.
Parse decimal 64-bit snapshot fields using explicitly typed uint64 arithmetic instead of FFI boxed arithmetic; retain original validation limits and signed conversion.

Replace string.buffer with public nupp.text Buffer selected through real nupp.spi.index and portable tablebuffer. Raw I/O currently copies bounded strings, unlike original putcdata/ref zero-copy path.
Retain original weak backing registry and component storage registry; isolated graph restore tests cover native owners/views and borrowed tags, not reconstruction of those external registries.
Extract four original direct storage test bodies; replace ECS registration setup with direct ffistorage.new, and native allocator/Buffer setup with VM APIs. Keep original assertions and bounds cases.
Supplement with exact unsigned/signed codec extrema, array codec indexing, nested raw-codec rejection, capture identity/detachment, and runtime graph alias preservation.
Exercise public Buffer FIFO length separately, including partial consumption, to guard ordinary-record metamethod dispatch used by raw row I/O.
notYetCovered: Pointer-bearing/bitfield aggregate admission, external raw allocator pointers, and ABI targets other than aarch64 macOS
Restoration/rebinding of global storage registration and weak backing metadata from isolated world graph snapshots
Original zero-copy raw FIFO path and actual three-archetype snapshot benchmark timing
patchReplay: In a copy of the original Tecs checkout, git apply each patch; each result exactly matches its adapted fixture file after remapping the test destination path.
